title: Reid 1985: muscle volume of erector spinae at xiphoid_to_pubis (mixed, unspecified)

imaging.plane: transverse scans at 0.5-2.0 cm intervals from xiphoid to symphysis pubis, normalised to 15 slices per subject
imaging.level_definition: whole muscle between xiphoid and pubis (average over slices)

quantity.name: muscle_volume
quantity.definition: muscle volume; volume between xiphoid and pubis only

source.sample: 28 living subjects (16 M, 12 F); archival CT scans

how_to_simulate: For each muscle, compute cross-sections of the model muscle on 15 equally spaced transverse planes from the xiphoid to the pubic symphysis.
Average the (anatomical) cross-sectional area over those slices, and compute the muscle volume.
Compare: ES left/right per side, ES total = both sides; RA value likely both sides together (paper does not split RA).

subject_model.source: Table 1: M age 54.6, height 172.6 (n=10), mass 74.7 (n=10); F age 52.1, height 159.4 (n=10), mass 63.8 (n=10)

extraction.check_notes: Values verified on rendered pages 279-280. Text prints ES total 31.74 and right 15.72 cm2; Table 2 prints 31.75 and 15.73 (table used).
